cancer_case.clinical_notes: Patient presents with palpable mass in upper outer quadrant of left breast. Core biopsy confirms invasive ductal carcinoma. Sentinel lymph node biopsy shows micrometastasis in 1 of 12 nodes. No distant metastases on staging CT. Patient is postmenopausal. Good performance status (ECOG 0). Family history: mother had breast cancer at age 58.

expected_treatment: Lumpectomy with sentinel lymph node biopsy, followed by adjuvant chemotherapy (AC-T regimen), radiation therapy, and endocrine therapy (Aromatase Inhibitor for 5-10 years)
trial_eligibility: Eligible for adjuvant endocrine therapy trials, genomic testing trials (Oncotype DX)
